Name: Weave Router 2.0
Tagline: Subscription Aware Coding Agent Router (GPT-6 Intelligence)
Topics: Open Source, Developer Tools, Artificial Intelligence
Description: Use Claude models in Codex and GPT models in Claude Code on your existing plans, routed to whichever has quota left. Weave Router 2.0 routes each coding agent request to the cheapest model that can get it right. On Terminal-Bench 4.0 and SWE-Atlas it matches GPT-6 Astra at half the cost, 2x faster. Powered by a new classifier scores task complexity and ache-aware switching that only moves when savings beat the rebuild cost.

Name: Appwrite 2.0
Tagline: The open-source cloud for agents and developers
Topics: Open Source, Developer Tools, Artificial Intelligence, GitHub
Description: Appwrite 2.0 is the second major generation of the platform. It replaces the engine underneath, rebuilds the Console on top, and expands what a project can hold: relational and schemaless and vector data, native PostgreSQL and MySQL engines, S3-addressable storage, a standards-compliant identity provider, and the network layer in front of all of it.

Name: Expand Board for macOS
Tagline: Expand ideas, concepts, and plans across limitless boards
Description: Expand is a spatial board for macOS. Place text, images, files, and shapes on an open canvas, then nest boards you can actually go into. Double-click the board to add something. Right-click to choose text, images, files, or shapes. The plus in the toolbar adds from the top of the window. Drag to arrange. Open a board to work inside it, then use the title-bar breadcrumbs to go back up.

Name: Thread
Tagline: AI journal that connects your thoughts into something bigger
Description: Thread is an AI journal and second brain for capturing thoughts, ideas, notes, and voice recordings. It automatically connects related memories, finds patterns in your thinking, and turns scattered ideas into meaningful threads. Capture anything in seconds, rediscover what matters, and turn your thoughts into actionable ideas with a private AI-powered memory system.

Name: Gemini 3.8 & 3.8 Live Extended Thinking
Tagline: Our most advanced Gemini Audio models yet
Description: Gemini 3.8 Live and Gemini 3.8 Live Extended Thinking are our most advanced live dialogue models yet, built for natural conversation.

Name: CreatorHat
Tagline: YouTube SEO tools for Safari featuring Apple Intelligence
Description: Find videos outperforming their channels, research YouTube keywords, and track your search rankings without leaving Safari. While your video uploads, CreatorHat transcribes it on your Mac and uses Apple Intelligence to suggest titles and a description inside YouTube Studio. Your transcript and AI writing stay on your Mac. $29.99/year after a 7-day trial, with no separate AI bill. Requires macOS 26+; AI features need Apple Intelligence.

Name: Jottoo
Tagline: AI meeting notes that turn into tracked tasks
Description: Jottoo turns meetings and notes into organised, deadline-tracked tasks — automatically. Record, upload, or type — no bot joins your call, nothing to install. Ask Jottoo anything about a past meeting and get the answer instantly. One flat plan, $13.99/month

Name: Twigg
Tagline: The context layer you never have to build
Description: Twigg is a stateful API for calling LLMs. Instead of rebuilding and resending your whole conversation on every request, you create a chat once and send only the next event. Twigg holds the state: it fits context to the target model's schema, compacts or truncates when it runs long, and routes the call. Control tool schemas, system prompts and context windows from the dashboard, and track usage and billing. Build anything from personal agents to enterprise apps. You never manage context again.

Name: PeakHour 6
Tagline: Real-time network monitor for Mac w/ detailed WiFi insights
Description: PeakHour 6 is a real-time network monitor for your Mac. Its on-device AI Advisor grades your connection from A+ to F and explains it in plain English. Plus Wi-Fi Intelligence, ISP and router details, speed tests and outage alerts. No account needed.

Name: Toki Coordination
Tagline: Your personal assistant to schedule + follow up on meetings
Description: Stop wasting 3 days scheduling a 30 minute group meeting or starting over every time someone cancels. Like a real executive assistant, Toki will email attendees, negotiate a time that works for everyone, follow up if needed, and send out invites. Toki will also help protect your time, architect your schedule, remember your preferences, and help you prioritize your most important tasks and urgent deadlines. And instead of paying tens of thousands, it's now free.

Name: Convo
Tagline: The AI copilot for people who sell
Description: Convo helps you win more deals by giving the right support while the conversation is happening. Handle objections, catch buying signals, ask the right questions and get instant answers from your company knowledge. After every call, Convo captures the risks, next steps and follow-ups so nothing that could move the deal forward gets missed.

Name: Fide Island
Tagline: Media, Notes, on-device translation + more in your Notch
Description: Turn your MacBook notch into a Dynamic Island for media, Apple Notes, on-device translation, calendar, files, clipboard and quick tools with Fide Island.

Name: Project Feed
Tagline: Project management with built-in file review
Description: Project Feed is a workspace for game developers, design teams and agencies. Share updates, plan tasks, edit docs and work on canvases together. Review images, video, audio, PDFs, 3D models, Rive files and sprite sheets. Turn feedback into tasks that link back to the review. Clients can approve selected updates or request changes in a portal. Includes chat, time tracking and analytics. Pro adds integrations and full API, CLI and MCP access. Free for up to 3 editors.

Name: flat.social
Tagline: Absurdly delightful 3D spaces where remote teams hang out
Description: A playful virtual space for team socials, events and classes. Spatial audio, mini games and no downloads. Free for up to 5 people, right in the browser.

Name: CAT ME app
Tagline: See Yourself or Your Friends as Cats
Description: The Cat Me app turns a photo of a person into their very own cat lookalike!  It’s simple and purr-fect:  1. Snap a picture of yourself or a friend. 2. Create a unique cat that matches their look and personality.  3. Share your new kitty with your crew. Each Purrtrait is generated by AI based on the original photo, transforming human features, expressions, hairstyles, and accessories into a one-of-a-kind cat. What would you look like as a cat?

Name: PhraseVault
Tagline: 20% off PhraseVault 3.0 + PIN-locked snippets
Description: 20% off PhraseVault 3.0 on phrasevault.app this hunt—auto-applied, no code. Lock one sensitive phrase at a time with a PIN, while everyday snippets expand across Windows and macOS. Source-available: inspect and verify the code.

Name: Pollen Create
Tagline: Your AI Assistant for Interactive Training
Description: Pollen Create is the AI training assistant built into Beekast. Describe the session you need, or drop in a deck or PDF you already have, and get a complete interactive training session in under a minute: structure, timing and interactive activities! Your get a live Beekast session you can facilitate in Teams, Zoom, Webex or a room. Better yet, Pollen explains its choices and can remember your habits, so you get personalized tips and advice along the way. The more you use it, the sharper it gets!

Name: Bundi
Tagline: Uptime and server monitoring that won't cry wolf
Description: Bundi is an owl that stays up all night so you don't have to. One slow response? It shrugs. Actually down? It emails everyone at once, then politely stops. Watches your URLs, cron jobs and server disks, so you can finally sleep. 🦉

Name: Shower Time
Tagline: One shower for the whole internet. One occupant at a time.
Description: A magical place to calm your mind. The water never runs cold, the pressure is perfect, and no one can bother you. Three minutes of pure bliss. Just don't kick yourself out.

Name: NexusOS
Tagline: The AI operating system that cites its sources
Description: Most AI tools answer from training data and hope you don't check. NexusOS runs live web research and cites every source. Upload your own documents and query them directly. Six AI agents handle research, analysis, marketing, sales and ops as multi-step workflows, pausing for your approval before anything consequential. Pre-registering now, first 500 get Pro free for a month.
